irac.issue: Whether a finding on title in a previous suit for injunction is res judicata in a subsequent suit for title
irac.rule: A finding on title in a previous suit is res judicata in a subsequent suit if it was directly and substantially in issue, and the decision was necessary for the adjudication of the principal issue. The test for determining this is whether the issue was necessary to be decided for adjudicating on the principal issue and was decided, and if the judgment was in fact based upon that decision.
irac.application: The court applied the test to the facts of the case and held that the finding on title in the earlier suit was necessary for the decision of the case, and therefore, the bar of res judicata applies.
irac.conclusion: The court decided point 1 accordingly, holding that the finding on title in the previous suit is res judicata in the subsequent suit.
